t01-book-expensive.observed_description: The same red hardcover book on the same wooden market counter and background as the cheap-book photo; the white price card in front of it now reads $20. No people or other writing.
t01-book-expensive.note: Usable in 3:2 (declared four_card false): the book and its $20 card read at 180 px; only the price differs from the cheap-book photo.

t02-different-price.observed_description: The same blue and red pens on the same wooden market counter as the same-price photo; the left card still reads $3 and the right card now reads $8. No people or other writing.
t02-different-price.note: Usable in 3:2 (declared four_card false): two different prices read at 250 px; the pens are small at 180 px but both cards stay readable.
